prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, restyle of an existing game location. Image 1 is an in-game screenshot of the boy Cairo skating inside the Mega Park in the game Yorimichi. Image 2 is another place in the same game and shows the art direction to match: soft painterly low-poly shapes, flat matte shading, pale lavender-grey rocks, autumn maples and ginkgos in rust, orange and gold, dark green pines, soft green grass, a clean blue sky. Repaint image 1 as the AFTER concept from exactly the same camera, with the same skater in the same pose. Every skating surface stays exactly as it is: the concrete bank, the bowl with its coping, the wooden deck and the painted ledge edges keep their shapes and places. The concrete keeps its pale weathered look with a softer, cleaner, slightly painterly texture; the bright blue paint becomes a faded indigo; the plywood becomes a warm honey-coloured wood. The scenery changes: the red sandstone cliffs become rugged lavender-grey volcanic rock with moss, ferns and small autumn maples in its ledges; the cacti, thin dead trees and desert scrub become the island's autumn trees; the beer billboard becomes a wooden notice board with a paper poster under a small roof; the metal scaffold light towers become tall wooden lantern poles; the shark banners become indigo cloth banners with a simple white wave crest. Keep it a raw, rugged skate spot. No UI, no labels, no extra text.
